list.name: website
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, website_id::text AS __value FROM website WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY name
list.definition: SELECT name AS __text, website_id::text AS __value FROM website WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS visiteurs FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)
SELECT count(DISTINCT visit_id) AS visites FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)
SELECT count(*) AS vues FROM website_event WHERE event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 1)::float / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT visit_id), 0) AS pages FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 1) AS "pages vues", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS visiteurs FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT url_path AS page, count(*) AS vues, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS visiteurs FROM website_event WHERE event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT referrer_domain AS site, count(DISTINCT visit_id) AS visites FROM website_event WHERE referrer_domain IS NOT NULL AND referrer_domain <> '' AND referrer_domain <> hostname AND $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT coalesce(country, '?') AS pays, count(*) AS visiteurs FROM session WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT coalesce(browser, '?') AS navigateur, count(*) AS visiteurs FROM session WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT coalesce(os, '?') AS os, count(*) AS visiteurs FROM session WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT coalesce(device, '?') AS appareil, count(*) AS visiteurs FROM session WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM website_event WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND website_id::text IN ($website)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT w.name AS site, w.domain AS domaine, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 1) AS vues, count(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS visiteurs FROM website_event e JOIN website w USING (website_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) AND e.website_id::text IN ($website) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
